justification.text: `1 / Real.log (Real.log ↑n)` is the problem's exponent scale 1/log log n in a little-o relation at `atTop`, which only constrains the tail; for n ≥ 16 we have log log n > 0, so the denominator is nonzero for every n the relation depends on and the finitely many small n with Lean's junk value are irrelevant.

This sits in `1 / log (log n)` inside a little-o along atTop, so only large n matter. For n ≥ 3, log n > 1 and log log n > 0, so the junk value at n ≤ 2 cannot change the asymptotic claim f(n) ≤ n^(o(1/log log n)) of the docstring.
